title: Check laptop battery status and capacity
summary: You can check your laptop's battery level and health using simple terminal commands. This helps you monitor power usage and troubleshoot battery issues.

steps.explain: Read the current battery capacity percentage directly from the kernel. Replace BAT0 with your battery name if different (e.g., BAT1, wacom_battery_0).

placeholders.name: BATTERY_NAME
placeholders.description: Name of the battery device, usually BAT0

steps.explain: Alternatively, use upower to get detailed battery information including health and voltage.
steps.cmd: for BAT_PATH in $(upower -e | grep BAT); do upower -i "$BAT_PATH"; done
